Item.Name: USER_ID
Item.Hint: Enter the user ID or 'ALL' for all users

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 select substr(user_id,5,6)
 into :ctrl_blk_1.user_id
 from system_users
 where substr(user_id,5,6) = :ctrl_blk_1.user_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :s_dummy_user_id := :ctrl_blk_1.user_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 if :ctrl_blk_1.user_id = 'ALL'
 then
 :s_dummy_user_id := '%';
 else
 show_error('1253');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.error_code is null
 then
 :s_dummy_error_code := '%';
 else
 begin
 select ve.error_code
 into :ctrl_blk_1.error_code
 from valid_errors_lab ve
 where ve.error_code = :ctrl_blk_1.error_code
 and exists (select uel.error_code
 from user_error_log uel
 where ve.error_code = uel.error_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 and user_id like :s_dummy_user_id);
 :s_dummy_error_code := :ctrl_blk_1.error_code;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1218');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: FROM_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter from date in MM-DD-YY format

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 IF :from_date > trunc(sysdate)
 THEN
 show_error('7022');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
END;

Item.Name: TO_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter to date in MM-DD-YY format

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from user_error_log
 where user_id like :s_dummy_user_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 error_code like :s_dummy_error_code and
 trunc(insert_dats) between nvl(:from_date,sysdate-365)
 and nvl(:to_date,sysdate);
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 clear_block;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.user_id');
 show_error('7025');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 go_block('error_logs');
 execute_query;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD

END;

Block.Name: ERROR_LOGS
Block.WhereClause: where user_id like :ctrl_blk_1.s_dummy_user_id and error_code like :s_dummy_error_code and trunc(insert_dats) between nvl(:from_date,sysdate-365) and nvl(:to_date,sysdate)

Trigger.Name: POST-CHANGE
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 select v.error
 into :s_error_desc
 from valid_errors_lab v
 where v.error_code = :error_logs.error_code;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
